protocol.scaling: 20,000 updates; one untimed process then five timed fresh processes; spawn-to-exit hrtime
protocol.throughput: 200,000 updates; three fresh processes; pilot chooses calls/batch, two warmup + seven measured batches; per-process median then median across processes
protocol.shapes: 2,000,000 named loads; same timing protocol as throughput
protocol.clock: Date.now, integer milliseconds per batch; process startup excluded for throughput/shapes
protocol.checksum: Each workload invocation checked; deletion requires undefined, not zero. Separate reference identity and key-presence probes.
protocol.note: rounds is authoritative per case (some confirmation measurements use five). Earlier passes remain in build/summary-*.json. Cases run serially on an interactive host, no CPU pinning.
